title: mime-tree: ParseError::InvalidRange.available is usize, breaks cross-platform serde
description: ParsedPart uses u32 for byte ranges explicitly to ensure identical serialized representation on 32-bit and 64-bit hosts (part.rs:46-47). But ParseError::InvalidRange { available: usize } serializes usize which is 4 bytes on 32-bit and 8 bytes on 64-bit. Cross-platform deserialization of a serialized ParseError will misread or fail. Change available to u64 (or u32 with saturating cast).
